Review Omi?

Omi has received positive feedback for its AI-powered wearable technology, praised for its ability to capture conversations and provide actionable insights. Users appreciate its seamless integration with mobile and desktop apps, enhancing productivity and organization. Some reviews highlight its potential in revolutionizing meeting management, with one user noting its impact on personalized follow-ups and ROI. However, there are concerns about delivery delays. Overall, Omi is seen as a promising tool in the AI and wearable tech space, with room for improvement in transcription accuracy and quality of life features.
